sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Sales of Maternity and Infant Care Commodities

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu – International Company (IC) regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law foundation with French Civil Law influence; distinct statutory offshore corporate regime for International Companies)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No standalone bilateral investment treaty currently in force for Vanuatu
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) – multilateral trade and economic integration treaty in force
No comprehensive double taxation agreement network; Vanuatu operates a territorial zero-tax regime for International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [CAP 222] as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2017 (compulsory beneficial ownership filing to VFSC); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act [CAP 291]; Financial Transactions Reporting Act [CAP 230]; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) directives; VFSC AML/CFT Guidelines for Registered Agents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu acceded to the Apostille Convention; effective 17 September 2008); consular legalization only for non-Apostille states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing bank in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (original letterhead, issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature verification plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from a lawyer, accountant, or corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualified professional in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: For corporate shareholders: certificate of incorporation, certificate of incumbency or good standing, and register of directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or licensed registered agent of the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the corporate shareholder approving the incorporation and shareholding in the Vanuatu International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or board of the shareholder company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners against the VFIU domestic list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and UK/EU consolidated sanctions lists; PEP status determination under FATF and VFSC guidance with enhanced due diligence, including source of funds and source of wealth verification, for PEPs, high-net-worth individuals, and negative-media matches.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC Corporate Registry – International Companies Name Search and Reservation (official portal: https://www.vfsc.vu; corporate registry e-services administered by VFSC licensed registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in Latin/Roman script and may be in English, French, or Bislama; statutory suffixes required: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', or 'Inc.'; no local-script transliteration requirement applies.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Vanuatu (in a manner implying State patronage)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the licensed registered agent submits an amended name application within 5 business days; a written administrative appeal with supporting justification may be lodged with the Registrar of International Companies at the VFSC within 14 days of the refusal; the Registrar's decision is subject to judicial review by the Supreme Court of Vanuatu; an approved name may be extended at VFSC discretion upon payment of the applicable fresh reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual or correspondence address is permissible for the e-commerce company's administrative and marketing functions, but it cannot substitute for the statutory registered office: the International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the office of a VFSC-licensed registered agent, which serves as the address for service of process. No local physical presence, staffing, or warehousing requirement applies to the online maternity and infant care retail activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the foreign operating company (estimated less than 5% annual probability of unannounced on-site inspection of overseas e-commerce operations); moderate-to-high for the licensed registered agent, which is subject to regular VFSC AML/CFT compliance inspections and documentary audits of UBO files without prior notice.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and reservation fee (International Company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC certificate of incorporation government fee (payable immediately following name clearance)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent onboarding, due diligence, and UBO filing preparation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Vanuatu International Company formation services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of passport, address proof, and corporate resolutions for each director, shareholder, and UBO
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff in the document's country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille authentication of three core dossier documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the country of origin (e.g., Secretary of State, DFAT, or MOFA)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank standard tariff for corporate reference letters

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English or French translation of origin-language documents (if applicable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for certified legal translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International courier of original notarized and apostilled documents to Vanuatu registered agent
Contingency reserve for full consular legalization if document origin is not an Apostille Contracting State
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Consulate or embassy of Vanuatu in the country of origin

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap. 222 (Vanuatu) as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2012; ss. 4-12 (incorporation procedure, memorandum, articles, and registration), s. 13 (registered office and registered agent), s. 16 (directors), s. 24 (secretary).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association submitted with Application for Registration (Form IC-1) to the Registrar of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no mandatory escrow account; authorized capital up to USD 50,000 is covered by the standard incorporation fee, and any excess attracts an incremental VFSC capital fee; shares may be issued without par value.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by written consent of the sole subscriber for and on behalf of the Company, as follows: (1) The allotment of one ordinary share of no par value to the subscriber is ratified and entered in the register of members. (2) The registered office is fixed at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the agent is instructed to file all required statutory notices. (3) [NAME] is appointed sole Director and [NAME] appointed Secretary until otherwise determined. (4) The Director is authorized to open bank and merchant accounts, onboard Stripe and PayPal, execute e-commerce and fulfilment contracts, and appoint agents. (5) This resolution takes effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, via licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent submits a Name Reservation Application with up to three proposed names in English (each ending in 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', or 'Inc.'). The Registry checks for identical or misleadingly similar names against the International Companies Register and reserves the approved name for 40 days.
required_dossiers: Proof of VFSC Registered Agent Licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for conflict, the agent re-files with the next alternate name; VFSC determines priority within 2 business days, and the 40-day reservation window restarts on approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and a Vanuatu notary public or other VFSC-approved attestation officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum (name, registered office clause, liability limitation, share capital) and Articles (board powers, quorum, indemnity, share transfer rules) in English. The subscriber executes both instruments before a notary public, who certifies identity and capacity; the agent countersigns as proposed registered agent.
required_dossiers: Identity and proof of address of the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC registry queries the documents, the agent rectifies the citation or drafting defect and re-submits within 14 days without forfeiture of the filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Registration Application and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the statutory declaration of compliance, executed memorandum and articles, and Form IC-1. The Registry validates the instruments against the International Companies Act and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique company number; the incorporation date is the certificate date. Standard completion is within 2 business days of complete submission.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory Declaration of Compliance by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is refused due to statutory non-compliance, the agent may appeal to the Registrar within 21 days; pure administrative defects are cured by corrected re-filing on the same business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convening of First Board Meeting and Filing of Officer and Registered Office Notices
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First Board of Directors (internal governance); VFSC International Companies Registry for statutory notifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first directors adopt the First Board Resolution ratifying share allotment, fixing the registered office at the agent's address, and appointing the secretary. The registered agent files the Notice of Registered Office and Notice of Directors and Secretary with VFSC within 30 days of incorporation and opens the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Director (each director)
Notice of Directors and Secretary (Form IC-3)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late submission of Form IC-2 or IC-3 attracts a VFSC late fee; cure is effected by filing the late notice with payment of the prescribed penalty and statutory declaration of the agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Share Certificates and Onboarding of Banking and Payment Rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Director and Secretary; regulated Vanuatu/international correspondent banks and payment processors (Stripe, PayPal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The director signs and seals share certificates and issues them to members. A corporate due-diligence pack (certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, director passports, beneficial ownership declaration) is compiled by the agent and presented to the bank and payment processors to satisfy KYC/AML and merchant onboarding checks. The company activates its Stripe and PayPal merchant accounts in its legal name to enable checkout and settlement.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incumbency and Certificate of Good Standing
Directors' and beneficial owners' passport copies and utility bills
Beneficial Ownership Register extract (Act No. 33 of 2016)
Corporate bank and payment processor KYC pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or processor issues a query, the registered agent issues a fresh Certificate of Incumbency, Certificate of Good Standing, or apostilled corporate documents within 1 business day; a designated payment-facilitation sponsor bank is engaged as fallback settlement route.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry, Commerce and Ni-Vanuatu Business
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial or trading operating permit required for online resale of maternity and infant care commodities (non-manufacturing, non-regulated goods)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) under the Environment Protection and Conservation Act, Cap. 283
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA registration required, as the activity is online retail distribution with no manufacturing, effluent discharge, or Schedule A listed undertaking
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for virtual e-commerce operations; any future fulfilment warehouse storing goods exceeding DEPC hazardous substance thresholds must register with DEPC and comply with Schedule 2 of the Vanuatu Waste Disposal Regulations, including containment and segregation of damaged or expired infant formula and medicines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: If a physical fulfilment warehouse is leased in Vanuatu, the Company must obtain a fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Services (Fire Service Act, Cap. 157), maintain a structural load survey confirming floor capacity, and secure a business premises clearance from the Vanuatu Municipal Council (Port Vila or Luganville); no workplace license is required since no in-person manufacturing workforce is engaged.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; corporate registry and tax-exemption certificates: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); foreign investment and business licensing: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA). Public portals: dcir.gov.vu, vfsc.vu, vipa.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act Cap. 222 through a licensed VFSC registered agent; 100% non-resident ownership is permitted, no minimum paid-up capital is required. Step 2: Obtain a VIPA Foreign Investment Certificate and pay the annual External Business Licence fee (e-commerce classified as Low_Risk_Standard). Step 3: Register with DCIR in ASYCUDA World to obtain a Customs Trader Code / Importer-Exporter Code for any physical import or export movements. Step 4: Apply to VFSC for the statutory 20-year tax-exemption certificate confirming immunity from all present and future Vanuatu direct and indirect taxes. Step 5: No TIN or VAT number is required for the IC because the entity is exempt from income tax, withholding tax, stamp duty and, once commenced, VAT; the IC remains non-resident for income-tax purposes provided central management and control is exercised outside Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax or withholding tax; therefore no check-the-box, pass-through, group-relief or hybrid mismatch elections exist, and no OECD Pillar Two qualified domestic minimum top-up tax has been enacted. The only statutory election is the IC's right to request a written 20-year tax-exemption certificate from VFSC under the International Companies Act, and the IC may elect to maintain non-resident status by keeping board meetings, accounting records and management functions outside Vanuatu.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) - the Value Added Tax Act has been enacted but its commencement order has not been issued, so no VAT or GST is in operational force in Vanuatu. The currently effective indirect taxes are customs and excise duties under the Customs Act Cap. 91, municipal turnover and business licence taxes under the Port Vila and Luganville municipal acts, tourism-related levies, and stamp duty under the Stamp Duties Act Cap. 70.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable while the VAT commencement order is pending. The dormant VAT legislation prescribes registration for businesses with annual taxable turnover above a threshold to be fixed by Ministerial Order (draft threshold VUV 10,000,000, approximately USD 84,000), with zero-rating for exports once activated. No registration threshold applies to the current customs duty or municipal turnover tax regimes, which operate transactionally rather than through a periodic turnover registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing clearance, real-time fiscal reporting, API transmission or digital stamping mandate is in force. ASYCUDA World is used only for customs declarations and duty assessment. The IC may issue ordinary commercial invoices through Stripe and PayPal settlement rails without government clearance or fiscal device requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Currently not applicable because no VAT/GST is in force; exported maternity and infant care commodities are outside the indirect tax base and no refund mechanism exists. If the dormant VAT is commenced, exports of goods and services to non-residents will be zero-rated, requiring evidence that title and risk passed outside Vanuatu, goods departed within 60 days of invoicing, and consideration was received within 180 days; input tax credits attributable to zero-rated supplies would be refundable on a quarterly basis.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World, VU-EXP form)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT payment receipt
Certificate of Origin where required by destination customs
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no income tax audit on International Companies; administrative scrutiny is limited to customs valuation, VIPA business licence fee returns and AML/CFT reviews of payment rail settlements. Under the Customs Act, a negligent false declaration attracts penalty duty of up to 200% of the duty evaded plus potential forfeiture of goods; under-declared licence fees trigger reassessment, a 100% surcharge and licence revocation by VIPA; breach of International Companies Act conditions may cause loss of the 20-year tax-exemption certificate, although no historical income tax is clawed back because the applicable rate is 0%. Should VAT be activated, fraudulent export zero-rating claims would attract a 150% tax-shortfall penalty, fines up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years, with retrospective clawback of refunded input tax and monthly compounding interest at 1.5%.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV; Banque de la Réserve de Vanuatu). The RBV regulates licensed banks and monetary policy; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the licensing and registry authority for International Companies, trust service providers, and other financial services intermediaries.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a fully convertible unified exchange system for both current and capital account transactions. There are no exchange control approvals, capital authorization requirements, or restrictions on the repatriation of profits, dividends, liquidation proceeds, or intercompany loan repayments from an International Company. The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) floats freely and can be exchanged through licensed banks; major currencies such as USD, AUD, EUR, and GBP may be held in domestic or offshore accounts without RBV permission. International Companies benefit from the absence of corporate income tax, withholding tax, and capital gains tax, so profit remittance has no tax barrier. The only practical frictions are AML/CFT source-of-funds verification, sanctions screening by correspondent banks, and each bank's internal risk appetite for offshore Vanuatu IC structures.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no prescribed timeline for repatriation of export receipts in Vanuatu. Proceeds from online sales, marketplace settlements, Stripe/PayPal payouts, and direct SWIFT customer transfers may be retained in the original foreign currency or converted to VUV at the account holder's discretion. The bank record must identify the underlying export transaction through the sales invoice, payment method, and shipping evidence; the Financial Intelligence Unit reporting obligation applies only when a transaction appears suspicious under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing framework.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium, but only with a small set of offshore digital EMI/neobank providers. Most EU/UK-licensed EMIs refuse Vanuatu International Companies due to perceived offshore risk, the absence of a Vanuatu EMI passporting regime, and sanctions/reputational concerns at their sponsor banks. Stripe and PayPal are available only as merchant payment acquirers, not as primary treasury accounts. For multi-currency liquidity, the safer legal route is a Vanuatu-licensed commercial bank account combined with an EMI's foreign-currency payout wallet, provided the EMI accepts the VU IC's corporate KYC and the EMI itself is licensed in its home jurisdiction.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statute expressly requires physical attendance, but in practice mainstream Vanuatu banks usually require at least one director or the ultimate beneficial owner to attend an in-branch interview at account opening. Remote account opening is occasionally permitted through a VFSC-licensed corporate service provider or a notarized KYC package plus video call, but USD-denominated accounts and accounts with external payment card facilities are far more likely to require physical verification in Port Vila. Documentary expectations include original passport, board resolutions, corporate register extracts, source-of-wealth questionnaire, and certified copies of the International Company's constitutional documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shell-structure risk: Vanuatu International Company with non-resident shareholders and no local physical operations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certificate of incorporation; Memorandum and Articles of Association; Certificate of Incumbency or Beneficial Ownership Register; board resolution naming signatories; certified passports of directors/UBOs; proof of residential address; detailed business plan for the ISIC 4791 e-commerce activity; commercial supplier and customer contracts; source-of-wealth statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment aggregator and marketplace risk: Stripe/PayPal used as primary sales settlement channels, making counterparty flows appear intermediated.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12 months of merchant statements from Stripe/PayPal; platform verification and onboarding evidence; transaction-level ledgers; website terms and refund policy; product safety certificates for baby and maternity supplies; chargeback and dispute reconciliation reports; supplier invoices and shipping/customs documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction / sanctions differential: correspondent banks applying heightened scrutiny to VU offshore structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of compliance with Vanuatu's Ant-Money Laundering Act; beneficial ownership declarations; negative sanctions screening results on all shareholders/directors/counterparties; appointment of a resident agent or professional director if appropriate; independent audit-ready financial statements; evidence that the entity has no nominee-shareholder arrangement beyond that disclosed to the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face director and infant health-adjacent product classification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Biometric or notarized identity verification; certified board minutes authorizing the account; supplier due-diligence pack including product origin, batch traceability, CE or equivalent compliance, manufacturer certificates; product liability insurance summary; regulatory confirmation that no Vanuatu statutory license is required for online retail of baby/maternity supplies.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or intercompany funding from shareholders should be sent via SWIFT MT103 from an established banking jurisdiction. The ordering field must disclose the true remitter/UBO, and the beneficiary line must match the International Company's legal name and bank mandate exactly. In field 70, use a clear purpose such as 'EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION / VU_IC' or 'INTERCOMPANY SHAREHOLDER LOAN / ISIC 4791'. Because Vanuatu has no exchange control permit, the only prerequisite is the bank's own internal pre-clearance: provide a board resolution authorizing the account, a subscription or loan agreement, source-of-funds documentation, and confirmation that proceeds will be used for working capital and supplier payments. For larger inbound amounts, notify the bank in advance to enable enhanced due diligence and to avoid holds caused by correspondent bank review.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade payments to overseas suppliers of maternity and infant goods should be settled by SWIFT MT103 for ordinary purchase orders, using the beneficiary bank's SWIFT BIC and the supplier's IBAN or account number in field 59 and invoice/PO references in field 70. For large or high-value bulk shipments, issue an irrevocable documentary letter of credit subject to ICC UCP 600 through BRED Bank (Vanuatu) or Bank of South Pacific (Vanuatu), with the supplier's bank acting as advising or confirming bank; typical documents include commercial invoice, full set of bills of lading, packing list, certificate of origin, and inspection certificate. Direct card payments or digital wallet disbursements should be avoided for supplier settlement because of VUV/USD conversion costs, low clearing limits, and weaker provenance documentation. All outward wires are subject to OFAC and UN/EU sanctions screening at the Vanuatu bank and at any US/EU correspondent bank; a clean compliance record materially reduces settlement friction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore VUV/USD and VUV/AUD plain-vanilla OTC forward contracts with an RBV-licensed commercial bank, supported by documented export/import invoices.
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV/USD used by international market-makers to hedge VUV receivables without settling in VUV.
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD for medium-term balance-sheet hedging of intercompany funding.
FX swaps for short-term working capital bridging between VUV and foreign currency accounts.
Zero-premium collars or barrier options if specifically approved by the counterparty bank and supported by board authorization and an underlying treasury policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of the date of incorporation of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalties apply immediately; continuous default beyond 6 months permits the Registrar to publish a Gazette strike-off notice, and if uncured within the notice period the Company is struck off and dissolved

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu registered agent / VFSC AML records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each incorporation anniversary and immediately upon any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-disclosure to the agent may trigger agent resignation, regulatory referral and AML administrative penalties; prolonged non-compliance can ground strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury (Inland Revenue)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax and no annual income tax return is required for an International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: None applicable while the Company remains offshore-tax-exempt and in good standing under the International Companies Act Cap 222

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VAT Commissioner)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable - no VAT registration required where supplies are made wholly outside Vanuatu; local taxable supplies of Vatu 5,000,000 or more in any 12-month period would trigger registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Nil for pure offshore sales; local taxable supplies without registration attract 13% VAT assessment, interest and penalties

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. International Companies are exempt from statutory independent audit under the International Companies Act Cap 222; an audit becomes mandatory only if required by the Company's constitution, a members' resolution, a lender's condition, or a VFSC directive.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed for International Companies; records must be kept in English sufficient to explain transactions and financial position. IFRS is the recommended standard for bank, PayPal and Stripe due diligence; simplified cash or accrual basis is acceptable for internal purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each International Company must maintain, through its Vanuatu registered agent, a current beneficial ownership record. Any transfer of shares requires director approval and immediate updating of the share register and UBO records, followed by an annual confirmation delivered to the agent on the incorporation anniversary; failure to disclose is an offence under the IC Act and Vanuatu AML/CFT law.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholder and board resolutions
Beneficial ownership register (maintained by the registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (statutorily exempt); USD 3,500 - 6,500 if a certified audit is voluntarily or contractually required

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax. International Companies are expressly exempt from all domestic income taxation and are considered tax-exempt offshore vehicles. No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions exist because the base tax rate is already zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists. Vanuatu International Companies are outside the income tax net. The sole recurring statutory filing is the VFSC International Company Annual Return submitted via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) electronic portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Return must be filed by 30 November each year; annual license fee must also be paid to the VFSC Registrar of International Companies by the same statutory deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent confirmation of company name, company number, and registered office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners need not appear on the return; the registered agent in Vanuatu submits the form on behalf of the International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement that the company has not engaged in prohibited or unlicensed activities within Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Statement filed by registered agent; no non-resident signature required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Indication of the current directors and shareholders on record.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders are permitted; data remains confidential and is not publicly displayed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the Annual Return by 30 November triggers a late penalty of 25% on the annual government fee, and continued non-compliance can lead to administrative dissolution of the International Company. No daily surcharge applies under the International Companies Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu imposes no domestic withholding tax on dividends, so no treaty relief protocol or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) is needed for dividend distributions. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network concerning dividend withholding because the source state tax is zero.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% for both resident and non-resident recipients. No Vanuatu withholding tax exists on cross-border royalties or interest. Treaty rate is likewise not applicable in the absence of a signed double tax agreement providing a lower rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in Vatu (VUV). Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation, no country-by-country reporting obligation, and no Local File or Master File requirement for International Companies. As the company is tax-exempt, transfer pricing could not affect Vanuatu tax liability.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not adopted Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) in the form used in BVI, Cayman, or Bermuda. An International Company is not legally required to demonstrate substantive economic activity in Vanuatu. However, banks and payment processors (Stripe, PayPal) routinely require a genuine commercial purpose, operational substance, and clear transaction records as part of their AML/KYC policies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Offshore Shell Company Abuse / Tax Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company to conceal the true beneficial owner, to divert e-commerce profits from a jurisdiction where the ultimate consumer resides, or to present a wholly inactive letterbox as an active trading business to obtain banking or payment processing facilities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act and Vanuatu Penal Code, conviction can lead to fines and, for directors/officers, imprisonment for up to 5 years. The VFSC may strike off the company and freeze its registered agent relationship.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil where the company is found to be a sham or fraud. Directors and beneficial owners become personally liable for Civil restitution of diverted profits, bank charges, and third-party losses. Travel bans may be issued by the Vanuatu Supreme Court in enforcement proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an online maternity and baby-supply business used as a front to pass illicit funds through bank accounts or through PayPal/Stripe settlement, including false invoices, round-tripping, or unattributed cryptocurrency conversions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act (Vanuatu) criminalises money laundering with penalties up to VUV 75 million or 15 years imprisonment. The Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) can freeze assets and report to the Public Prosecutor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal criminal liability. Civil forfeiture orders can attach personal assets. Travel bans under mutual assistance requests are routinely issued, and extradition may follow.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Incurring debts, especially importing inventory from third parties or advancing customer refunds, while knowingly insolvent and using the exempt offshore status to avoid any corporate tax registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Companies Regulation and general common law, fraudulent trading carries unlimited fines and imprisonment. The Court may wind up the company and appoint a liquidator with retrospective investigation powers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the company's debts if they knowingly carried on business with intent to defraud creditors. The veil of incorporation is removed and personal bankruptcy proceedings may follow.
